name: Warrior of Dawn procs at its authored 10% chance, not never (#4787)
contract: Warrior of Dawn 560648's Description reads "Melee damage dealt now has a $h% chance to...", rendered from its own DBC ProcChance = 10. Its spell_proc row (rev_20260909_04_templar_completion.sql) sets Chance to 0, which SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs defers to the DBC ProcChance (rev_20260919_20_coa_proc_chance_parity.sql's documented intent), so the effective proc chance is 10%, not 0%. Over enough real melee hits the proc (561156, cast directly by the aura's own Proc() handler, so spell_cast_count is the metric per the README) must fire at least once.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Accumulate roughly 60 auto-attack swings at a ~2 sec weapon speed
SETUP: enough real melee hits landed to trust a 10% chance over ~60 trials
DISCRIMINATING: Warrior of Dawn's proc (561156) fired at least once, not zero
